title: Completeness at a single section is invariant under restriction of scalars
statement: For a morphism φ:R→B of commutative ring sheaves on a small site, an arbitrary unbounded M in D(B), U in C and f in R(U), the restricted complex is f-complete in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-complete-element] if and only if M is φ(f)-complete. Restriction is computed on Q's chosen representative as in [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. No ideal or flatness hypothesis is used.

proof.text: Products in the derived categories exist: replace each object by a K-injective resolution, take the termwise product, and use its universal property. The multiplication-tower criterion and the Roos distinguished triangle identify completeness with invertibility of one minus the product shift.

source.place: Tag 0997, product model for the derived inverse limit

proof.text: Exact restriction is a right adjoint, so it preserves derived products. It reflects isomorphisms, since under the exact derived functor cohomology is underived restriction, which is conservative. The product comparison thus preserves and reflects invertibility of one minus shift.

source.place: Tag 099C, scalar independence of the underlying abelian-sheaf computation

proof.text: The factorization isomorphisms for exact derived slice restriction identify restriction-before-slicing with slicing-before-restriction. These isomorphisms commute with multiplication: on a section the equality is precisely the naturality equation for φ. Conjugating the two product shifts and applying the preceding detection of isomorphisms proves both implications.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictScalars_completeElement_iff
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R B : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : R ⟶ B)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B))]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).over U))]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      (((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B).over U))]
    (M : DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B)))
    (U : C) (f : R.obj.obj (op U)) :
    IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J R
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map φ)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.objPreimage M))) U f ↔
      IsRingedSiteCompleteElement J B M U (φ.hom.app (op U) f)
